_meta.description: Pre-parsed ATO tax-guidance reference content, extracted once into structured form and ingested deterministically via transport:s3 + mode:map. Durable tax-risk concepts anchored to their governing provisions; not a specific entity's tax position (that is a run conclusion).

guidance.title: Part IVA — general anti-avoidance rule
guidance.summary: Empowers the Commissioner to cancel a tax benefit obtained under a scheme entered into for the dominant purpose of obtaining that tax benefit. The primary integrity rule considered when a structure's dominant purpose may be tax-driven.

guidance.title: Division 7A — deemed dividends
guidance.summary: Treats certain loans, payments and forgiven debts by a private company to shareholders or their associates as unfranked deemed dividends unless placed on complying loan terms. A common private-group compliance risk.

guidance.title: Transfer pricing — arm's length principle
guidance.summary: Requires cross-border conditions between related parties to reflect arm's length conditions; the Commissioner may make transfer-pricing adjustments where they do not. Requires contemporaneous documentation to access penalty protection.

guidance.title: Thin capitalisation
guidance.summary: Limits the debt deductions an entity can claim where its debt exceeds prescribed thresholds, targeting excessive gearing (especially for multinational groups).

guidance.title: R&D tax incentive
guidance.summary: Provides a tax offset for eligible research-and-development activities and expenditure; eligibility of activities and expenditure is a recurring area of ATO/AusIndustry scrutiny.

guidance.title: GST on taxable supplies
guidance.summary: Goods and services tax of 10% applies to taxable supplies; registration, tax invoices, input-tax credits and correct characterisation of supplies (taxable/GST-free/input-taxed) are core compliance areas.

guidance.title: Public rulings system (TR 2006/10)
guidance.summary: Explains the public rulings system: a public ruling is the Commissioner's binding opinion on how a tax law applies, and taxpayers who rely on a public ruling are protected from underpaid tax, penalties and interest to the extent the ruling applies.
